import re
old = '''def parse(text):
    parts = text.split(",")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    while len(fields) < 3:
        fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "amount": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}'''
new = '''def parse_row(text, *, strict=False):
    parts = text.split(",")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    if len(fields) < 3:
        if strict:
            raise ValueError("expected at least three comma-separated fields")
        while len(fields) < 3:
            fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "cents": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}'''
files = {f'billing/{n}.py': read(f'billing/{n}.py')['text'] for n in ['alpha','bravo','charlie','delta','echo','foxtrot','golf','hotel','india','juliet','kilo','lima','mike','november','oscar','papa']}
changes = {'billing/api.py': new + '\n'}
for p,t in files.items():
    t2 = t.replace('from .api import parse\n', 'from .api import parse_row\n').replace('= parse(text)', '= parse_row(text)').replace('"amount"', '"cents"')
    assert t != t2, p
    changes[p] = t2
commit(changes)

print(run('python -m pytest -q tests 2>&1 | tail -5'))
